knowledge_base.content: Reservations can be cancelled free of charge up to 48 hours before check-in. Cancellations within 48 hours of check-in are charged one night's room rate.
Guests can change reservation dates or room type online up to 24 hours before check-in, subject to availability, or by contacting the front desk directly.
Room availability and current rates can be checked for any date range through the booking widget; rates vary by season and room type and are confirmed at the time of booking.
Standard check-in is 3:00 PM and check-out is 11:00 AM. Early check-in and late check-out are available on request, subject to room readiness, and may incur an additional fee.
If a charge on your folio looks incorrect, the front desk can pull an itemized invoice and review each line with you; disputed charges are corrected or refunded within 5 business days.
A refundable security deposit may be held at check-in and is released back to the original payment method within 3-5 business days after check-out, pending a room damage check.
Room service is available from 6:00 AM to midnight, with a limited late-night menu after 11:00 PM. Breakfast room service can be ordered the night before for early delivery.
Extra towels, pillows, or minibar restocking can be requested any time through the in-room phone or chat; standard housekeeping requests are fulfilled within 30 minutes.
Wi-Fi is complimentary throughout the hotel. The pool and gym are open 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM daily; the spa operates by appointment, bookable at the front desk or via the concierge.
We take noise complaints seriously — please contact the front desk immediately and we will address the disturbance or offer a room change where available.
Any issue with room cleanliness or broken fixtures is escalated to housekeeping/maintenance immediately; guests are offered a room change or a service credit depending on the issue.
Concerns about staff conduct are taken seriously and reviewed by hotel management; guests are encouraged to share specifics so the matter can be properly investigated.
